name: GitHub Workbench
description: Automate GitHub PR review and issue handling in Paseo: a board covering your repos and PRs/issues you authored elsewhere, a sidebar pending badge, an editable pre-dispatch panel (prompt, agent/model, thinking effort, permission mode), follow-up comments in the original agent, then merge or comment back.

zh-CN.name: GitHub 工作台
zh-CN.description: 在 Paseo 中自动化 GitHub PR 评审与 Issue 处理：看板覆盖名下仓库与你在别人仓库提的 PR/issue，侧边栏未处理徽章，派发前可在面板编辑提示词与 agent 配置（agent/模型、思考档位、权限模式），新评论复用原 agent 跟进，再合并或评论回写。
